vadsrijk.loot.ankerknots.flavour.0: It once held a little fishing boat in place. Now it holds you.
vadsrijk.loot.ankerknots.flavour.2: There's still a bit of seaweed on it. Just leave it.
"Every hit a blob. Every blob a buddy."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_klodderkroontje.flavo: "Heavy is the head that wears the blob. Also very sticky."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_lichtzwamhelm.flavour: "Never scared of the dark again. Just a little pink."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_pluisboog.flavour.0: "The arrows stick to everything. Including you."
vadsrijk.loot.baas_wortelwambuis.flavour: "Grows along with you a little. Water on Sundays."
vadsrijk.loot.bliksemstaf.flavour.0: "A little tube of lightning in a glass orb."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesembroek.flavour.0: "With pockets full of pollen. No sneezing."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemjak.flavour.0: "Light as a leaf, tough as a twig."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemjak.flavour.1: "Picked in The Canopy Sea, ironed by a beeguh."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.0: "Smells like spring. And a little like caterpillar."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.1: "There's always a petal blowing off it."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemkap.flavour.2: "A bee thought you were a flower."
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemstaf.flavour.0: Something is always blooming on it. Even in winter.
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemstaf.flavour.2: A butterfly lives in the top flower. It doesn't pay rent.
vadsrijk.loot.bloesemtrippers.flavour.2: "Soft enough not to wake a caterpillar."
vadsrijk.loot.boorbroek.flavour.1: "With an extra pocket for spare drill heads."
vadsrijk.loot.bubbelvest.flavour.0: "Every button is a bubble. No poking."
vadsrijk.loot.buitcape.flavour.0: "A Mika's lost cape. Full of cheese crumbs."
vadsrijk.loot.buitvest.flavour.0: "Pockets full of stolen stuff. Empty now. Yours now."
vadsrijk.loot.buitvest.flavour.2: "Looted from a Mika, so fair and square."
vadsrijk.loot.dadelpalmknots.flavour.1: "Sometimes dates fall out. Yummy after a fight."
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.0: It leaks a little. That's how it's supposed to be.
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.1: Every arrow is filled with a splash of pond chonk.
vadsrijk.loot.druppelboog.flavour.2: Found under a waterfall that said 'blub' really loudly.
vadsrijk.loot.duinvalkboog.flavour.0: "For shots all the way over the next dune."
vadsrijk.loot.duinvalkboog.flavour.1: "A little vultureguh feather on the string."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarscape.flavour: "Handy as a sunshade at a picnic."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarslaarzen.flav: "Sand in, sand out. That's how it goes."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarsmantel.flavo: "There's still a bit of pink sand in the folds."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarstulband.flav: "With two little holes for guh ears."
"Keeps the sun out of your eyes and the sand out of your hair."
vadsrijk.loot.duinwandelaarswanten.flavo: "Warm by day, cool at night. How?"
vadsrijk.loot.eikelkatapult.flavour.0: Acorns from the Sporewood. They pop open in a little puff of shroom.
vadsrijk.loot.eikelkatapult.flavour.1: A squirrel once gave this a very angry look.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.0: Every hit echoes three valleys further.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.1: Heavy, slow and very, very convincing.
vadsrijk.loot.galmhamer.flavour.2: The smith of Sugarbowl also uses it to crack nuts.
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.0: "You can hear the mountains singing softly in it."
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.1: "An echo that never stops. How snug."
vadsrijk.loot.galmoorbel.flavour.2: "Echoes when you nod. So nod a lot."
vadsrijk.loot.galmpantser.flavour.0: "Rings softly when you knock on it. Don't."
vadsrijk.loot.galmpantser.flavour.1: "Did anyone hear that? That was your armor."
vadsrijk.loot.golfbreker.flavour.0: It cuts through waves, woes and gray showers.
vadsrijk.loot.golfbreker.flavour.1: Glitters like the sea at five in the afternoon.
vadsrijk.loot.harpoenkruisboog.flavour.0: "Taken from a Mika Harpooner. Now it does good things."
vadsrijk.loot.harpoenkruisboog.flavour.2: "The rope has been replaced with a ribbon."
vadsrijk.loot.harsarmband.flavour.0: "A drop of resin with a little fly inside."
vadsrijk.loot.harsketting.flavour.0: "There's a tiny pink crystal in the resin."
vadsrijk.loot.harsketting.flavour.2: "Hard as a golem, pretty as a sunset."
vadsrijk.loot.honingarmband.flavour.0: "It's not sticky. Really not. A little."
vadsrijk.loot.honingring.flavour.1: "A drop of honey, caught in gold."
vadsrijk.loot.honingring.flavour.2: "The bees buzz when you wear it."
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.0: The string is made of frozen cuddle wool. Don't lick it.
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.1: Shoots fast. Your fingers do get cold, though.
vadsrijk.loot.ijspeesboog.flavour.2: A Sky Falcon would be jealous of it.
vadsrijk.loot.ijswantjes.flavour.0: "Cold on the outside, warm on the inside."
vadsrijk.loot.ijzelslofjes.flavour.0: "Sliding is a choice. These slippers choose yes."
vadsrijk.loot.ijzelslofjes.flavour.1: "Warm on the inside, icy on the outside."
vadsrijk.loot.kaaslaarzen.flavour.0: "Yes, they're made of cheese. No, don't eat them."
"Click, click, click: as quick as a caravan bell."
"The colors of the old caravan guard."
vadsrijk.loot.karavaanwachtlaarzen.flavo: "With a little compass in the heel. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderhesje.flavour.0: "Slippery on the outside, cozy on the inside."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.0: "Sticks to your little ears. It's supposed to."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.1: "Blob chic, now in the color cheerful."
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkapje.flavour.2: "Wahoog! says the cap. Caps don't talk. Right?"
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.0: A sword of hardened slime. Every hit slurps back a little chonk.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.1: Doesn't stick to your hands. Does stick to your enemies.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderkling.flavour.2: Forged by a blob that didn't need it anymore.
vadsrijk.loot.klodderstuiters.flavour.0: "Boing. Boing. Boing. You get used to it."
vadsrijk.loot.knaagvachtje.flavour.0: "All the gnawing has been washed out. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.knaagvachtje.flavour.2: "There's still a little crumb in the pocket."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelharnas.flavour.1: "Washable at 30 degrees. Not in the dryer."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelharnas.flavour.2: "Knights of the Snuggle Order wear this with pride."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelketting.flavour.0: "A cuddle around your neck, all day long."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelketting.flavour.2: "Granny guh knitted it. Out of iron."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelknots.flavour.0: "A cuddle with extra powers of persuasion."
vadsrijk.loot.knuffelknots.flavour.1: "Moss green and a tiny bit chonky."
vadsrijk.loot.koraalstaf.flavour.1: Your heals smell like the sea.
vadsrijk.loot.koraalstaf.flavour.2: A tiny fish lives inside. He helps out.
vadsrijk.loot.koraalwantjes.flavour.1: "Knitted by a coral goblin. He had help."
"Rings like a little bell when you get a cuddle."
"See-through enough to show your little heart."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalhelmpje.flavour.1: "Sparkles so hard your own shadow blinks."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkling.flavour.0: Forged from a crystal needle that wouldn't sing. Now it does.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkling.flavour.2: Sparkles so hard the Echo Wolf has to sneeze.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkroon.flavour.0: "The gray has been polished out. Almost."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalkroon.flavour.2: "A Splinterling wore it as a head. Used to."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.0: "There's a tiny pink light inside. It winks."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.1: "Fits any guh finger. Guhs don't have fingers."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalring.flavour.2: "Found inside a Crystal Spider. Don't ask."
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.0: A piece of rose quartz from the wall of Sugarbowl. Nobody misses it. Almost nobody.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.1: Glows when you think of hot chocolate.
vadsrijk.loot.kristalstaf.flavour.2: Crystal magic: just like regular magic, but shinier.
vadsrijk.loot.kussenzwaard.flavour.1: "Stuffed with real guh down. Don't tell the guhs."
vadsrijk.loot.lampioncape.flavour.0: "Flutters like a string of lanterns in the wind."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionjurk.flavour.0: "Soft as lantern silk, warm as a party night."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionjurk.flavour.1: "Swirls when you twirl. Go on, try it."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionmuts.flavour.2: "Folded from party paper and good cheer."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.0: "You walk on a little cloud of party."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.1: "They jingle like little bells on the pier."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionslofjes.flavour.2: "Perfect for a little dance by the campfire."
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.0: A little lantern always glows inside. At night too. Especially at night.
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.1: Slow, warm and very, very pink.
vadsrijk.loot.lampionstaf.flavour.2: The party starts wherever you stand.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.0: An old lantern of the Tree Folk, still lit.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.1: Light in the dark, fire for whoever gets too close.
vadsrijk.loot.lantaarnstaf.flavour.2: Old Knot says he used to read by it.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.0: The string is a vine that loves to help.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.1: Shoots as fast as a little squirrel runs.
vadsrijk.loot.liaanboog.flavour.2: Smells like rain in the canopy.
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.0: "Still warm from a Mika head. Yuck."
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.1: "The lamp still works. The Mika's lights are out."
vadsrijk.loot.mijnhelm.flavour.2: "Smells a bit like cheese and gunpowder."
vadsrijk.loot.mossloffen.flavour.0: "Walks quietly. The moss does the work."
vadsrijk.loot.mossloffen.flavour.2: "Don't leave them outside, they'll take root."
vadsrijk.loot.oasefluit.flavour.0: "Play a little tune and everyone feels better."
vadsrijk.loot.oasefluit.flavour.1: "Carved from oasis reed. Sounds like running water."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.0: "From the deepest shell in the lagoon."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.1: "Round, smooth and a little bit magical."
vadsrijk.loot.parelring.flavour.2: "Maybe the Sea Snoot gave it away himself."
vadsrijk.loot.plakpantoffels.flavour.1: "Sticks to the floor, the stairs and your heart."
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.0: Arrows with little pink plumes. They tickle, and then they hurt.
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.1: The string is made of stretched snuggle wool. Nyeg!
vadsrijk.loot.pluisboog.flavour.2: Aiming is easy: just think of something sweet.
vadsrijk.loot.pluishamer.flavour.1: "Forged by a smithguh with a lisp."
vadsrijk.loot.pluisoorbel.flavour.1: "With it you can hear the chonk rustle."
vadsrijk.loot.pluiswantjes.flavour.0: "Warm, soft and still a solid smack."
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.0: Every page is a piece of the northern lights. Read it at night.
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.1: Chapter 1: how to stay warm. Chapter 2: fire. Lots of fire.
vadsrijk.loot.poollichtboek.flavour.2: Smells of pine trees and warm socks.
vadsrijk.loot.raatkruisboog.flavour.0: Built by a beekeeper guh with a plan.
vadsrijk.loot.raatkruisboog.flavour.1: The arrows are a little sticky. They're supposed to be.
vadsrijk.loot.regendruppeloorbel.flavour: "Sparkles in every color of the rainbow."
vadsrijk.loot.roze_ring.flavour.1: "Shines a little when you say nyeg."
vadsrijk.loot.roze_ring.flavour.2: "Found in a blob. Rinsed off, promise."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenketting.flavour.1: "A little gift from Gorge Mother Rosie."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenkromzwaard.flavour.0: "Curved like a dune, sharp as a cactus."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenkromzwaard.flavour.1: "For the knight who wears a shield and a smile."
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.0: The orb on top glows pink whenever a dechonked creature is nearby.
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.1: Smells of cotton candy and a little bit of magic.
vadsrijk.loot.rozenstaf.flavour.2: Made from the branch where the very first guh took a nap.
vadsrijk.loot.saffraanring.flavour.1: "Smells just a tiny bit of rice."
vadsrijk.loot.saffraanstaf.flavour.0: "A little ball of saffron fire on a stick."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenbroek.flavour.0: "With a pocket full of sand. That's never coming out."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenhelm.flavour.0: "You hear the sea when you put it on."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenhelm.flavour.1: "A hermit crab lived in it first. He was fine with it."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenketting.flavour.1: "Picked up by hand on Snuggletide Beach."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenlaarzen.flavour.2: "For those who want to stand firm in the surf."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenpantser.flavour.0: "Hard on the outside, mother-of-pearl on the inside."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenpantser.flavour.1: "Every shell is a little gift from the waves."
vadsrijk.loot.schelpenwanten.flavour.0: "Snip-snap, just like a crab. But nice."
vadsrijk.loot.schemercape.flavour.0: "Made from the very last bit of evening."
vadsrijk.loot.schemercape.flavour.1: "You walk just a little faster in it."
"Sturdy as a root, bendy as a branch."
"There's a drop of resin on it. Not sticky. Usually."
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.0: As heavy as a piece of bark ten years old.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.1: Slow. Very slow. But then: BOOM.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshamer.flavour.2: The Tree Folk built their little houses with it.
vadsrijk.loot.schorshelm.flavour.0: "A piece of the oldest tree in the world."
vadsrijk.loot.schorshelm.flavour.1: "Someone bonks you on the head? You won't even hear it."
vadsrijk.loot.schorslaarzen.flavour.0: "For those who want to stay put."
vadsrijk.loot.schorslaarzen.flavour.1: "Even a Rot Hog can't push you over. Almost can't."
vadsrijk.loot.schorspantser.flavour.2: "The Tree Folk would be proud. We think."
vadsrijk.loot.schotsbroek.flavour.1: "Sturdy as an ice floe, less slippery."
vadsrijk.loot.schotsbroek.flavour.2: "With extra knee patches for out on the lake."
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.0: All the pages stick together. The spells work anyway.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.1: Chapter 1: Blub. Chapter 2: Blub blub. Chapter 3: a cliffhanger.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmboek.flavour.2: Read aloud from it and you heal a little. Bite into it and you don't.
vadsrijk.loot.slijmmutsje.flavour.0: "Fits like a glove. A slimy glove, but still."
vadsrijk.loot.slijmmutsje.flavour.1: "Smells of mint and a little bit of blob."
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.0: "Knitted by a guh with cold ears."
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.1: "Keeps your head warm and your thoughts cool."
vadsrijk.loot.sneeuwmuts.flavour.2: "There's still a snowflake in it. It's staying."
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.0: Fires candy cane bolts. Red-hot candy cane, mind you.
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.1: Slow to reload, sweet as a sledgehammer.
vadsrijk.loot.snoepkruisboog.flavour.2: Don't lick it. Really don't. Not even a tiny bit.
vadsrijk.loot.spiegelketting.flavour.0: "You can see yourself in it. You look great."
Built from a Mika Drill Tower. They want it back.
Loads slowly, hits hard, says nothing.
vadsrijk.loot.sporencape.flavour.0: "Smells like the forest after the rain."
vadsrijk.loot.sporenmantel.flavour.0: "Coughing is allowed, just not into your sleeve."
vadsrijk.loot.sporenoorbel.flavour.1: "A spore moth lost it. Finders keepers."
vadsrijk.loot.steelbroek.flavour.0: "Made from a shroom stem. It was fine with it."
vadsrijk.loot.steelbroek.flavour.2: "Goes with any hat, especially a toadstool."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartcape.flavour.0: "The Mother Oasis is on it too. Very small."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartcape.flavour.1: "A map you never have to fold."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenkaartmantel.flavour: "Take a look at night: it sparkles along."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenoorbel.flavour.0: "A little shooting star, caught in silver."
vadsrijk.loot.sterrenwachtkap.flavour.0: "An old hood of the Star Guhs."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.0: "Crackles a bit when you put it on."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.1: "Forged in a thunderstorm. A small thunderstorm."
vadsrijk.loot.stormarmband.flavour.2: "It makes your hair stand on end."
vadsrijk.loot.stormboog.flavour.1: "Arrows as fast as the wind above the clouds."
vadsrijk.loot.stormboog.flavour.2: "Cloud Watchers use it to shoot kites loose."
vadsrijk.loot.takkenknots.flavour.0: A branch of the world tree. It still grows a little when nobody's looking.
vadsrijk.loot.takkenknots.flavour.2: The tree dropped it all by itself. Honest.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.0: Warm at the top, cozy at the bottom.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.1: Also used for roasting marshmallows. Mostly for that, really.
vadsrijk.loot.vlammenstaf.flavour.2: Fire is strong against shrooms. The shrooms know it too.
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.0: The string is an old kite string. It sings in the wind.
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.1: Shoots a little bit with the wind. Handy!
vadsrijk.loot.vliegerboog.flavour.2: There's still a little bow tied to it.
vadsrijk.loot.vliegercape.flavour.0: "With every gust you feel like a kite for a moment."
vadsrijk.loot.vliegercape.flavour.1: "There's still a bit of kite string on it."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisbotknots.flavour.0: "An old baby bone of Mother Cloudwhale's. She had plenty to spare."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisketting.flavour.0: "A singing little shell from Mother Cloudwhale."
vadsrijk.loot.walvisketting.flavour.1: "Hold it to your ear and you'll hear her humming."
vadsrijk.loot.woestijnroosring.flavour.0: "A desert rose of pink sand, hard as stone."
vadsrijk.loot.woestijnroosring.flavour.1: "Fits any finger. Even your second ring finger."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkenstaf.flavour.0: "On top spins a little cloud that rains on whoever needs it."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkenstaf.flavour.1: "Your heals smell like rain on a summer day."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkring.flavour.0: "A teeny tiny cloud swirls around inside."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkring.flavour.1: "Cool on your finger, warm in your heart."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthandschoenen.flav: "The little Cloudwatch crest is on them."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthelm.flavour.0: "Polished until you can see your own ears in it."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachthelm.flavour.1: "It comes with a little feather. Always."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtkuras.flavour.0: "Light as a cloud, sturdy as a cuddle."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtkuras.flavour.1: "On the chest: an embroidered little whale."
vadsrijk.loot.wolkwachtzwaard.flavour.0: "The sword of the Cloudwatch: sharp, but polite."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelbroek.flavour.1: "Roots find the way. Now you do too."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelbroek.flavour.2: "With a pocket for a lantern beetle."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelkroon.flavour.1: "Braided by something that has been sleeping for a very long time."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelmantel.flavour.0: "Smells of earth and a little bit of egg."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelstappers.flavour.0: "Your feet find the ground, even in the dark."
vadsrijk.loot.wortelstappers.flavour.1: "Sneaking comes naturally. Handy near a Deaf Seer."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_boorbril.flavour.0: "With these goggles you see exactly where it hurts."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_boorhamer.flavour.0: "Still warm. Don't put it in your pocket."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_galmklauw.flavour.0: "Strike with this and you'll hear the mountains sing back."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_ijspelsmantel.flavo: "Warm inside, ice-cold to anyone who touches you."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_schaduwloze.flavour: "You never see the first shot coming."
vadsrijk.loot.z2baas_spiegelstaf.flavour: "Don't look into the orb too long. It looks back."
"Warm as an egg in a nest."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_kooisleutel.flavour: "Whoever opens the cage makes friends for life."
"Soft as down, light as a feather."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_lantaarnstaf.flavou: "The light of the Tree Folk never goes out."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_paraplu.flavour.0: "A bow that also keeps the rain off."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_roofklauw.flavour.0: "It sees you from farther away than you see it."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_roquefortsabel.flav: "Smells of the sea. And of cheese. Mostly of cheese."
vadsrijk.loot.z3baas_touwknots.flavour.0: "One tug and they're all lined up neatly."
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_enterhaak.flavour.0: "He grabbed plushies with it. You grab Mikas with it."
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_kaasdoek.flavour.0: "It still smells of Pinkie's toe cheese. A lot."
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_lagunelampion.flavo: "The little light that made the Sea Snoot sing again."
vadsrijk.loot.z4baas_slurfstaf.flavour.0: "Pffft! A little salt water comes with the deal."
vadsrijk.loot.z5baas_moersleutel.flavour: "He turned valves shut with it. You turn them open again."
"A piece of Thunderbelly, now pink and cheerful."
"Now it only rains little pink drops. And only on you."
vadsrijk.loot.z5baas_vermommingsmantel.f: "Turn it inside out and you're someone else. Almost."
